game_outcomes.qualification: This is a diagnostic of an already rejected policy, not a complete-terminal-game promotion gate or new Elo rating. The raw evaluator did not persist per-game truncation flags, so the exact adjudicated map IDs cannot be established from this artifact alone.

concentration.qualification: The repeated score vectors show a persistent decision pattern, not proven identical full game states. Neither candidate observations within a game nor turns in one long trajectory are independent samples.

descriptive_game_outcome_overlap.qualification: Association only; local native reply-score regret is not a counterfactual terminal-outcome label. Adjudicated games are included because the raw evaluator lacks per-game censoring flags.

raw_artifacts: Remote scratch /tmp/antiyoy-residual.n17QTu/procedural-duel-hybrid-native-full-audit-6361000-fixed{,-summary}.json; outputs are not committed to the repository
interpretation: Auditing every turn exposes a repeatable frozen-model-reply ranking error on one long seat-one trajectory that the earlier one-in-eight sample largely obscured. The aggregate 1107 seat-one regrets are dominated by that trajectory; map-paired seat evidence remains inconclusive. A second long trajectory repeats one score pattern without a comparable ranking failure. Neither observation proves that correcting a local ranking would win those games or yield a strong distilled policy.
decision: Keep the slower hybrid rejected and unrated. Do not retune on seed6361000, run reserved hybrid confirmation seed6357000 or final promotion seed6300000, or deploy it. A new predeclared study should first capture per-game action-limit censoring and test exact terminal counterfactuals at divergent whole turns on fresh independent maps, then require complete both-seat games and runtime/profile gates before any policy promotion.
